messages:
nina-cs: quick alert — three trial accounts reported lower-quality semantic search and intermittent 504s during vector indexing after today's runtime deploy. two are in final-week renewal. tagging eng/sre + legal for comms.

raj-eng: investigating now. early traces show an indexing worker hitting backpressure when processing long documents with the new batching logic. can reproduce on staging with large payloads.

sam-sre: opened INC-2026-200; applying temporary rate-limits to indexing queues and diverting jobs to warm standby nodes. monitoring error rates.

priority-bot: Incident INC-2026-200 | priority: medium-high | status: mitigating | link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-200

nina-cs: CS needs a one-paragraph note for affected contacts: short impact, immediate mitigation, ETA window for fix, data safety, and goodwill offer. concise please.

raj-eng: tech blurb for CS: "Cause: indexing worker backpressure from new batching logic causing intermittent timeouts. Mitigation: temporary rate-limits and reroute to standby; build a fixed batching artifact. ETA for validated fix ~24-72 hours; rollback possible sooner."

leo-legal: wording: state "no customer data loss or exfiltration detected." keep ETA window rather than exact hours under 24. ensure outbound comms are archived in incident drive.

nina-cs: draft email for the three trials: 

Hi <Contact>,

We observed reduced relevance in semantic search results and occasional 504 errors for some index/upload requests after a runtime update today. Engineers applied temporary rate-limits and are rerouting heavy indexing jobs while we validate a fix. We do not detect any customer data loss or exfiltration. We expect a validated mitigation within 24-72 hours and will update you sooner if we rollback or complete the fix earlier.

As a courtesy, we will apply a small account credit to impacted onboarding usage and offer a priority technical review to optimize indexing settings for your workload. Reply to reserve a slot.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Support

sam-sre: portal status line suggestion: "rate-limits applied; rerouting heavy indexing jobs; fix validation in progress; monitoring success metrics."

nina-cs: plan recap: 1) eng signoff on draft 2) targeted emails to 3 trial contacts + portal post 3) apply credits + offer review calls 4) RCA within 72h with root cause and permanent fix ETA.

raj-eng: will DM per-account error deltas and quick traces to help renewals outreach. filing PR for a long-index e2e test and additional queue metrics.

sam-sre: mitigation stable at 30m; expanding reroute.

nina-cs: thanks team. sending after portal post is live and uploading sent copies to cs-incident-archive for retention.
